text: An unobvious way to invigorate the brain and switch on the body: 2–3 minutes of walking backward on a flat, safe surface (a corridor, a clearing). Walk slowly, with your hand against a wall for support if necessary. This engages new neural connections, improves coordination, gently strengthens the legs, and “pulls you out” of looping thoughts. If you do this every day, then after a few weeks you will notice that a sense of inner collectedness and confidence has appeared.
